assessment.type: comprehensive security audit, manual code review, npm audit SCA, and isolated dynamic verification
assessment.dynamicTestingEnvironment: Isolated local Next.js server on port 3199 with temporary scratch SQLite DB copy and synthetic Org A (Owner/Member/Viewer) & Org B (Owner/Member) accounts

summary.releaseRecommendation: CONDITIONALLY READY FOR STAGING (App-layer findings remediated & verified; external cloud sandbox/Postgres/CI gates remain deployment tasks)

findings.title: Demo-user authentication fallback allows unauthorized access when session cookie is present but invalid
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-001 (Confirmed: Cookie mv_session=invalid-arbitrary-token returned HTTP 200 and 8 subscriptions owned by user_demo_001)

findings.title: Project creation/listing/upload endpoints lack authentication and workspace authorization
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-005, DT-006 (Confirmed: Org B user listed Org A's projects, created a project in ws_synth_a, and uploaded a ZIP archive into ws_synth_a)

findings.title: Preview manager executes DB-controlled start commands on host with shell and inherited environment
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed (spawn with shell:true and env:{...process.env} at src/lib/preview-manager.ts:41-47)

findings.title: Preview proxy endpoint lacks authentication and enables unauthorized localhost preview access
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed (no auth/requireProjectAccess check; direct fetch to http://localhost:${preview.port}${path})

findings.title: Notification ID endpoints allow unauthenticated/unauthorized object modification and deletion
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-009 (Confirmed: Org B user modified and deleted Org A's notif_synth_a1 with HTTP 200)

findings.title: Executions listing endpoint returns all executions when projectId is omitted
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-007 (Confirmed: Org B user retrieved Org A's exec_synth_a via GET /api/executions)

findings.title: Proxy/request gate only checks session cookie presence and is not a complete server-side authorization control
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-001 (Confirmed: missing cookie returns 307 redirect, but any non-empty mv_session passes through)

findings.title: Hardcoded development secret fallbacks for authentication and encryption keys
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-002 (Confirmed: token forged offline with 'modelvault-dev-secret-change-me' authenticated as Org A Owner on GET /api/auth/me)

findings.title: Missing anti-automation controls: no rate limiting, lockout, or CSRF defenses on sensitive cookie-auth flows
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed (no rate-limit or Origin/CSRF check in app layer)

findings.title: ZIP upload pipeline lacks resource limits and robust archive hardening
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-006, DT-013 (Confirmed: basic ../ Zip Slip filtered, but no size/entry/ratio limits and binary UTF-8 corruption present)

findings.title: User enumeration and weak registration/password posture
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-004 (Confirmed: duplicate email returns HTTP 409 'Email is already registered')

findings.title: Session lifecycle lacks revocation, rotation, and strong invalidation controls
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-003 (Confirmed: captured session cookie replayed after POST /api/auth/logout still returned HTTP 200 on /api/auth/me)

findings.title: Secret handling and logging controls may expose sensitive operational data in logs/errors
findings.owasp: A09:2025 Security Logging and Alerting Failures
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed

findings.title: Git command execution and workspace operations have insufficient isolation and policy boundaries
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed (branchName passed to git checkout without '--' separator; hooks/protocols not disabled)

findings.title: Missing baseline security headers and browser hardening controls
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed

findings.title: Verbose internal error details returned to clients in multiple routes
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed

findings.title: Insufficient input validation on several endpoints outside shared Zod schemas
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed

findings.title: Dependency and supply-chain security posture not continuously verified in CI
findings.dynamicVerification: Confirmed absence of .github/workflows and CI security checks

findings.title: SQLite/dev DB fallback and Vercel /tmp copy behavior are unsafe for multi-tenant production assumptions
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review & git history confirmed (prisma/dev.db committed in git history)

findings.title: Execution/workflow routes simulate agent behavior and write synthetic artifacts, creating auditability and trust-boundary ambiguity
findings.owasp: A09:2025 Security Logging and Alerting Failures
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed

findings.title: No evidence of sandbox isolation controls, egress restrictions, or container hardening in repository
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed

findings.title: Security testing coverage is incomplete: no automated CI gates or cloud staging validation
findings.dynamicVerification: Local npm audit and 13 dynamic API tests executed; external cloud/DAST/SAST toolchains not present in CI

findings.title: Unauthenticated / cross-tenant exposure of execution details and live SSE event streams
findings.component: Executions Detail & SSE Event Stream APIs
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-007 (Confirmed: Org B user retrieved Org A's execution prompt and live SSE event payload ORG_A_STREAM_DATA with HTTP 200)

findings.title: Unscoped organization directory endpoint leaks all tenants' users and bcrypt passwordHash fields, and allows unauthorized organization creation
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-010 (Confirmed: GET /api/organizations returned all 8 organizations, 11 member emails, and user.passwordHash values)

findings.title: Missing ownership check and negative-cost injection on POST /api/api-usage, plus unverified foreign keys on /api/billing and /api/subscriptions
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-011 (Confirmed: Org B user posted cost:-9000 to Org A's api_synth_a1, inflating Org A prepaidBalance from 500 to 9500 and setting totalSpent to -8990)

findings.title: Cross-execution review comment manipulation (IDOR) and missing authorization on workflow catalog & orchestrator planning
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-008 (Confirmed: Org B user resolved Org A's cmt_synth_a1 via PATCH /api/executions/exec_synth_b/comments)

findings.title: Silent prisma.project.findFirst() fallback on non-existent project ID and server filesystem path disclosure in /api/projects/[id]/files
findings.dynamicVerification: DT-012 (Confirmed: GET /api/projects/nonexistent_id_999/files with dummy cookie returned HTTP 200 with proj_fintech_001 data)

findings.title: GitHub OAuth lacks CSRF state parameter / PKCE and links accounts solely by unverified GitHub profile email
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed (no state parameter or PKCE in authorize URL or callback handler)

findings.title: Potential RangeError crash in verifySession on malformed signature length, un-sandboxed same-origin preview iframe, and unvalidated URLs
findings.component: Session Verification, Preview Iframe, Notification/Billing URLs
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed

findings.title: Verification Engine (/verify) performs client-side-only regex checks and POST /api/executions/[id]/approve lacks commit/diff digest binding
findings.dynamicVerification: Code review confirmed

findings.title: Confirmed vulnerable transitive dependencies (dompurify <=3.4.16 via monaco-editor, deepmerge-ts, effect via prisma) and .env / AUTH_SECRET mismatch
